title: MCP tools gained text and a voice
summary:
Assistants gained text and speech tools, the text API gained two models and private-by-default chat requests, and the community gallery grew.

The Pollinations MCP server expanded beyond image generation. Assistants can now generate text, produce spoken responses, speak supplied text verbatim, and list available models and voices. A new JavaScript speech-to-text example shows how to send audio for transcription.

The text API added `mistral-roblox` and `phi-mini`. Requests to `/openai*` and `/v1/chat/completions` are now marked private by default. Qwen Coder's configuration gained an 8,000-token maximum, and Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite moved to its non-preview model ID.

The project listings added Azad-sl’s text-to-speech app and FreeAI, which combines chat, image generation, and voice synthesis. OkeyAI API Playground was removed from the directory.

highlights.title: MCP can speak now
highlights.text: AI assistants can generate text, make spoken responses, speak supplied text verbatim, and discover available models and voices through the Pollinations MCP server. [Explore MCP tools](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

highlights.title: Mistral Roblox joins chat
highlights.text: Use `mistral-roblox`, a Mistral chat model routed through Scaleway. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistral-roblox).

highlights.title: Phi Mini joins chat
highlights.text: Use `phi-mini` for Phi-4 Mini Instruct through the text API. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=phi-mini).

highlights.title: Chat requests default private
highlights.text: Requests to `/openai*` and `/v1/chat/completions` are now marked private by default. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: More Chinese-language creative apps
highlights.text: The community project gallery added a text-to-speech app with selectable voice styles and FreeAI for chat, images, and voice synthesis. [Explore community apps](https://pollinations.ai).
